_: Every screen and card of the device UI. build.mjs fails when an entry has no story whose `screen` names it, and when spa/src has a tab (live/tabbar.js TABS), wizard step (main.js STEPS) or collapsible card (Collapsible id="...") that no entry lists under `ui` -- so a new card cannot ship without a story. Entries with an empty `ui` are screens the scan cannot see (captive portal, diagnosis card, Wi-Fi form).

captive.what: Wi-Fi setup page of the captive portal (firmware/components/captive_portal/captive.html)

wizard-hardware.what: Wizard step Device: variant and pins (steps/hardware.js)

wizard-meter.what: Wizard step Smart Meter: detection, profile, GUEK, key check (steps/meter.js)

diagnosis.what: Diagnosis card with fix buttons (diag.js), on Done and on the Live tab

history-csv.what: History tab: load profile export card

device-fw.what: Device tab: firmware and restart card (live/firmware-card.js)
